authority: Each authority or sector owns its SQLite database and files; root PV selects exact verified lane heads.

lane_artifact_folders.selection: Each initialized lane owns its database, schema history and files. Generate only the MMD, DOT, pointer and natural outputs required by its declared consumers.
lane_artifact_folders.reuse: Preserve useful existing filenames, schema meaning and behavior in each separate lane folder.
lane_artifact_folders.ownership: One lane contract owns each database and file path; cross-lane references retain project, lane, revision and content hash.
lane_artifact_folders.named_custom_instances: Sources owns immutable adapter registrations. Each custom__<name> instance has its own sectors/<lane_id>/ database, schema history, files and derived views; it inherits the retained Custom meanings without sharing business rows or mutating the global registry.

lane_specific_logic.rule: Adapt each earlier lane's useful logic independently. Do not replace different lane meanings with a universal MMD/DOT/pointer template.
lane_specific_logic.shared_mechanisms: Path isolation, revision checks, hashes, atomic publication and bounded shared tools may be common implementations without imposing one artifact shape.

pointer_policy.default: SQLite keeps lane identity, ownership and current revision. Preserve a lane-specific pointer file where its workflow needs one; there is no mandatory pointer for every lane.
pointer_policy.materialize_when: The lane contract has a consuming workflow for its pointer, including useful existing semantics for state, artifacts, snapshots or navigation
pointer_policy.binding_evidence_location: SQLite artifact metadata or the lane's existing manifest/pointer shape; these common bindings do not mandate a new universal pointer file schema.
pointer_policy.missing_graph_policy: No graph export is required without a declared consumer; do not manufacture empty graphs or per-lane placeholder files
pointer_policy.publication: Advance the current pointer only after the matching source revision and derived content are verified under project writer fencing

other: Only relationships explicitly defined by that profile's operation contract

format_selection: Use only the format an actual viewer, downstream tool or user request consumes. Do not generate both formats merely because the old route did.
semantic_equivalence: Two formats of the same declared view must agree semantically. A lane may define different named MMD and DOT projections with distinct scopes; bind and validate each against its own contract.
tooling: Tools and dependency installations are shared. A profile declares only the shared tool references required by its supported operations; no automatic per-lane tooling bundle.
admission_test: Inspect the earlier lane's own files and logic
Identify the authoritative records and lane contract
Preserve the useful file subset in its separate lane folder
Remove only unnecessary artifacts and duplicated dependencies
bounded_views: Large graphs use a declared query scope and budgets; a limited view never claims complete lane coverage
refresh: Invalidate affected views on contract/source changes and regenerate from authoritative records; never reconstruct authority by importing a stale graph
current_selection: The owning lane database selects its immutable views; root PV coordinates the verified lane heads.
pointer_snapshot_scope: Optional lane-specific navigation files describe their immutable snapshot; there is no second mutable current-file selector.
implementation_status: The five core authority views and two Universe views use their owning lane databases and real cross-lane source readers. V4-D125 qualifies that source integration and packaged MCP protocol separately from installation. Exact Root PV coordinates come from live Universe inspection; topology exports omit their own publication effects. Federation views belong to a separate coordinator project and preserve member hash references. V4-D126 backs up every recorded natural-view generation, current selector and schema history file with the coherent Root PV and exact separate lane database bytes; fresh-root recovery validates that complete inventory and preserves the original project.

graph_execution.source_projection: Deterministic LangGraph and Python Graphviz source exports; packaged projections omit runtime readiness and optional analysis observations.
graph_execution.runtime_analysis: Selected lane graph exports run bounded Rustworkx in the owned graph worker; pointer-only exports do not start that worker.
graph_execution.native_dot: Explicit dot_validation=native requires the DOT format, a hash-verified shared Graphviz binary and a supported configured client. Default dot_validation=source makes no native execution claim.
graph_execution.host_context: Derive native profile from the authenticated connected client; environment profile strings do not authorize an export or attest a native task.
graph_execution.vm: Persistent and ephemeral VM clients require the existing verified durable remote connection before native graph work.
graph_execution.fallback: A failed requested native validation never downgrades to source-only export.
graph_execution.refresh: Retain the existing selected format subset and DOT validation choice. Bind the exact selected snapshot during source-change admission and recheck it before invocation. Check the selected native client, tools and workers before source effects. An adopted source-change task must permit Graphviz_dot when preserving a native-validated view. Exact unchanged bindings, graphs and verified files reuse the current snapshot with original producer evidence; a request receipt records reuse without creating a new view generation.
